Tests Markdown output format

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"output_format\":\"markdown\"}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].mime_type)
    print(result.results[0].content)
    print(result.results[0].metadata.output_format)

asyncio.run(main())
```
